title: Shark
titleNative: 샤크
synopsis: Sharks don't have lungs, but they do have to breathe oxygen to survive. Instead of breathing air, though, sharks get oxygen from the water that surrounds them. So they have to move around, if they stop moving for a while, they sink into the water and die, So Sharks have to move and move constantly from birth to death. The same goes for you. If you want to survive, keep moving, then you will be the best hunter... like a shark. (Source: Kakao, translated)

title: Aoku Somero
titleNative: 蒼く染めろ
synonyms: Dye Blue, Even If You Die
synopsis: The older brother was a genius. At just 15 years old, he was already receiving offers from top teams around the world — a true “treasure of Japanese soccer.” Would it be Madrid or Barcelona? Or perhaps a prestigious club in England? The entire country was watching with anticipation to see where he would go. But the young prodigy made a surprising choice: he decided to attend “a Japanese high school where his underachieving younger brother would be enrolling.” “Because there’s someone amazing there that I want to play with!” With the “genius older brother” and the “underachieving younger brother,” let them stir up a storm in the world of soccer! (Source: Magazine pocket)

title: Jueshi Zhan Hun
titleNative: 绝世战魂
synopsis: In Jang Lin, the martial arts path cannot be walked for those who cannot awaken the martial spirit. In this world, only those who have a strong fighting spirit can communicate with the heavens and the earth. Born in Linshui, Chen Nan was an unparalleled genius with talent and thought he would become a great fighter in the future. However, Chen Nan was struck by lightning rays while practicing his martial arts and obtaining the spirit of divine battle, which was able to settle. To break the ultimate rule of Jang Lin, Qin Nan didn’t know that his fighting spirit possessed a great secret that would slowly discover mystery as the story continued.

title: Napoleon: Era of the lion
titleNative: ナポレオン ─獅子の時代─
synopsis: This is a story of the life of Napoleon. The tale begins just before the Battle of Austerlitz. Then, it jumps back to 1769 to tell the story of Napoleon's life from the very beginning, including the circumstances of his birth, his childhood on Corsica, and his difficulties as a Corsican boy in a French school. All of these experiences eventually culminate in his becoming the famous Emperor of the French.

title: Namaiki Asahi-chan wo Wakarasetai
titleNative: ナマイキ旭ちゃんをわからせたい
synonyms: I Wanna Set This Cocky Asahi-chan Straight
synopsis: Ryou is in his last year of high school, and he's enjoying his otaku life to the fullest — except for a certain girl who's really getting on his nerves. She goes to his school and she's none other than his cocky two-year younger childhood-friend, Asahi-chan! Though she's suppose to be his kouhai, she's always teasing him whenever she gets the chance! On the other hand, if she gets teased back, she starts acting like "you can't say anything mean to me because I'm a cute girl." Furthermore, she's "afraid of people with practically no friends who can't be honest with their feelings." Someday, somehow, someone has to set this cocky Asahi-chan straight! (Source: Pocket Magazine, translated)

synopsis: Kitami, a boy serving as class representative, is struggling to get a girl named Toujou — who transferred into the class in the middle of the semester — to fit in better with the class. title: Gisou Kareshi ni Aisarete Shimaimashita
titleNative: 偽装カレシに愛されてしまいました
synopsis: "Next time, please listen to my request." On the night of her 32nd birthday, female doctor Megumi is dumped by her boyfriend of seven years, who tells her, "I've found someone else I want to protect." He's cheating on her... and breaking up with her...! What's more, she's invited to her engagement party by the thief-like woman, Kurumi (she knows it!!). In a desperate situation, Megumi asks Akiho, a young doctor with an enlightened personality, to pretend to be her boyfriend, in order to get back at the two men. However, Akiho didn't agree to be her fake boyfriend out of goodwill, as she has another plan...!? "Surely this can't be the end," Akiho says with a serious face. What is her "request"...?! What is happiness for a woman?! A turbulent love comedy dedicated to independent women begins!! (Source : Mecha Comic, translated)

title: Shujinkou no Osananajimi ga, Wakiyaku no Ore ni Guigui Kuru
titleRomaji: Shujinkou no Osananajimi ga, Wakiyaku no Ore ni Guigui Kuru
titleNative: 主人公の幼馴染が、脇役の俺にグイグイくる
synopsis: Kazuki Ishii has his life turned upside down — and is driven to suicide — after getting caught up in the romantic entanglements of his friend Teruhito Amada, who is wildly popular with the opposite sex, like the hero of a romantic comedy. However, a miracle occurs, and time is rewound back to the morning of his high school entrance ceremony. In his second chance at life, Kazuki tries to keep a low profile, avoid making friends, and live a peaceful life. But for some reason, Meiko Hikata — Amada’s childhood friend and a cool beauty known as the “Ice Empress”—begins to take an interest in him. (Source: Natalie, translated)
